thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-west-2' reporting elevated 429s and request throttling. Autoscale attempted but failed to provision burst due to cloud quota error. Impact: ~30% requests 429 across multiple tenants. Paging on-call.

sara: I'm looking at Grafana now, spike started ~12:28 UTC. @miguel can you pull autoscaler logs and cloud quota errors?

miguel: grabbing logs. autoscaler shows repeated failures: "Provisioning failed: QuotaExceeded: Insufficient elastic IPs / GPU quota". Also seeing backoff state on the scaler.

sara: Ok. Triage plan: 1) Enable manual burst override for pool so reserved nodes can be used; 2) Apply short-term per-tenant traffic caps to limit noisy tenants; 3) Notify customers and create support incidents; 4) Request cloud quota increase. @kai can you flip the burst override?

kai: flipping now: `/ops toggle-burst --pool=dedicated-us-west-2 --enable --reason "emergency capacity"` — this will hit the control plane and provision reserved burst nodes, ~30-60s.

ops-bot: audit-log: user kai executed toggle-burst pool=dedicated-us-west-2 action=enable at 2026-03-17T12:34:45Z

sara: Confirmed control plane accepted the toggle. New nodes are provisioning. Latency dropping on /v1/generate but some 429s remain concentrated on tenant acme-corp.

miguel: applying per-tenant cap: `/admin set-tenant-cap --tenant=acme-corp --qps=0.5 --duration=30m` -> result: success. This should shed noisy traffic while burst nodes warm up.

dina: I'll open support incidents for the affected customers and post a status note. Suggested blurb: "We're seeing temporary throttling due to a sudden traffic surge. We've enabled emergency capacity and applied short-term rate limits; please retry with exponential backoff. Our team is monitoring."

sara: SG. Add that we expect resolution in ~30–45m once burst and quotas stabilize.

kai: submitted cloud quota request to provider (support case #CS-99872) for additional GPU and EIP limits. Until approved, manual burst override remains in effect. Also added an entry in infra tracker: INFRA-2187 to follow up on permanent quota bump.

ops-bot: note: manual-burst-override on dedicated-us-west-2 will auto-revert in 2h unless extended by oncall.

sara: handing off to @miguel for monitoring and follow-up. Current status: burst enabled, per-tenant caps applied, cloud quota request submitted, support incidents open. 429s now down to ~2.5% overall.

miguel: acknowledged. I'll keep a 15m cadence check and escalate if 429s don't fall below 1% in 30m. I'll also confirm rollback of per-tenant caps once load normalizes.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. next_check=1808124356 (15m).
